hints.title: Most frequent task
hints.body: The task that appears most often determines the minimum number of gaps.

hints.title: Build a frame
hints.body: Place the most frequent task, then fill the gaps between its occurrences with other tasks or idle time.

hints.title: Count tied tasks
hints.body: Several tasks may share the maximum frequency; each needs a final slot in the last frame.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
counts = frequency of each task
maximum = largest frequency
tied = number of tasks with that frequency
frame = (maximum - 1) * (cooldown + 1) + tied
return max(frame, len(tasks))
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
